question: Who among the following Indian Cricketers is the autobiographer of ‘Believe: What Life and Cricket Taught Me’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Suresh Raina**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Suresh Raina **takes us through the challenges he faced as a young cricketer.in his book,** ****Believe: What Life and Cricket Taught Me** 
 
• This is the story of the lessons he learnt and the friendships he built.
 
• **Suresh Raina is a former Indian international cricketer.** 
 
• He occasionally served as stand-in captain for the Indian men's national cricket team during the absence of the main captain. He played for **Uttar Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Sharad Dravid **is an Indian cricket coach and former captain of the Indian national team, currently serving as its head coach. 

 
 
• Dravid was the Head of Cricket at the **National Cricket Academy, **and the head coach of the India Under-19 and India A teams.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar **AO BR is an Indian former international cricketer who captained the Indian national team. 
 
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli** is an Indian international cricketer and former captain of the Indian national cricket team. 
 
 
• He plays for** Delhi in domestic cricket and Royal** **Challengers Bangalore** in the Indian Premier League as a right-handed batsman
